newsitem.title: UK: Avis Europe sees share float at 108p-126p per shr.
newsitem.headline: Avis Europe sees share float at 108p-126p per shr.

text.p: Car rental company Avis Europe, which plans to list part of its capital in London, said on Friday that its indicative share offer price would be between 108p and 126p per share.

The company, 77.1 percent held by leading Belgian car importer and distributor D'leteran, expects a market capitalisation of between 628.9 million stg and 733.7 million after the issue of 215 million shares, which it expects will raise around 237 million stg.
The proceeds of the listing will be used to pay off debts, invest in development of rental activities and buy back General Motors stake in Avis Europe.
D'leteren plans to remain the majority shareholder in Avis Europe.
Avis Europe forecast pretax profit in its prospectus of 101.3 million for the year ending February 28, 1997, up 20 percent on the previous period.
The company said it would have recommended a dividend of 3.5p per share had the shares been listed been listed for the whole of the 1997 financial year.
